_doc: Operator back door for token-onboard.py. Re-read on every run — edit freely, no restart, no code change. Adding a provider here is how this flow covers 'any site with a free token'.

_fields.kind: cli = hand the token to the tool's own credential store (we stop holding it) | env = keep it in the vault and inject it per-command | llm = add it to the free-API pool matrix
_fields.install: argv; the token is fed on STDIN, never interpolated into this list
_fields.verify_http: preferred proof: an in-process request to the provider's identity endpoint. Works for services that ship no CLI, and keeps the secret out of argv.
_fields.verify: fallback proof: argv for the tool's own status command. rc 0 = OK, rc 127 = tool not installed (reported as NO-TOOL, not as a missing token).
_fields.vault_path: _secrets path for kind=env. Never a literal value.
_fields.service_key: key written into _registry/auth-inventory.json on success, so auth_check.py stops reporting UNKNOWN

github.expiry_note: Fine-grained tokens cap at 1 year; classic tokens allow 'No expiration'.
github.note: gh reads the token from stdin until EOF. Doing this interactively on Windows needs Ctrl+Z then Enter, which is exactly the trap that made this look hung; the engine closes stdin for you. Two verifiers on purpose: during ingest the token is still in hand, so verify_http asks GitHub about THAT token; afterwards it is only in gh's keyring, so `gh auth status` can report authenticated without saying which credential is active — the engine labels that weaker answer rather than passing it off as the same proof.
github.vault_note: 2026-10-06: gh's own OAuth token (read:org) mirrored here by ai_darkhero/scripts/gh_auth_sync.py so the gh-auth-sync rider can re-login gh without the operator when gh's keyring entry is lost

cloudflare.expiry_note: Leave TTL blank for no expiry.
cloudflare.install_tool_hint: no install needed; use `token-onboard.py exec cloudflare -- npx -y wrangler ...`
cloudflare.note: Stored in the vault rather than exported to the machine: a permanent env-var change needs operator authorization, and process-scoped injection achieves the same for the one command that needs it. Account id is on the dash overview page, right sidebar.

vercel.note: Read-only use for now: the account is paused at 300% of the Fluid Active CPU allowance, and a token lets us read per-project usage to attribute it without the dashboard.

fly.note: Billed 1.01 USD on 7/2 and 5.04 on 8/2. Token is for reading usage and for tearing machines down after the Cloudflare migration, not for new deploys.

claude_code.token_url: (no dashboard page — run `claude setup-token` in a terminal; it opens the browser OAuth and prints the token)
claude_code.expiry_note: setup-token issues a long-lived token; re-run the same command to mint a fresh one.
claude_code.note: This is the credential the phone->machine path is waiting on: everything else in _registry/claude-remote-ready.json is measured green and the only blocker is claude_not_authenticated. kind=env rather than cli because `claude` has no `auth login --with-token` verb — the CLI's own store is written by the interactive OAuth alone, so the token stays in the vault and is injected per command. Verified through claude-remote-exec.py check --probe rather than a raw argv: that engine resolves claude.CMD via PATHEXT (a bare ['claude'] argv fails under CreateProcess) and its probe spends one real call to prove the token WORKS instead of merely existing. There is no HTTP identity endpoint for a setup-token credential, which is why verify_http is absent here.

groq.note: All 5 existing keys return organization_restricted. A new key from a clean org is the only fix; re-adding the same one will not help.

gemini.note: Header auth, not ?key= — a credential in a query string is logged by every proxy and by Google's own access logs.

cf_ai.note: verify_http proves the TOKEN is live, not that Workers AI is bound to it — the AI endpoint needs the account id in the URL path. Treat OK here as necessary, not sufficient; key-health.py is what actually probes inference.

xai.note: grok-2-vision — 簽到表 OCR 的第二票。挑不同廠商是為了讓錯誤去相關，同一家讀兩次不算交叉驗證。

deepseek.note: Console mints the key once and never re-shows it: press 创建 API key -> name -> 复制, then `token-onboard.py capture deepseek` (clipboard read in-process). Endpoint verified 2026-09-03: GET /models, /v1/models and POST /chat/completions all answer HTTP 401 "Authentication Fails" without a key, so a 200 from /models proves the token. Pay-as-you-go account (no permanent free tier); key-health probes inference via api-matrix endpoint deepseek (model deepseek-chat).

anthropic.note: Consumer: dsh (http://127.0.0.1:3080) provider anthropic, whose managed credential ref is ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (deriveKeyRef in dsh-client-ui-settings-models/lib/client.js). Endpoint verified 2026-09-03 without a key: GET /v1/models -> 401 "x-api-key header is required"; POST /v1/chat/completions -> 401 "Invalid Anthropic API Key" (OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint, which key-health probes with schema openai). The Claude Pro/Max OAuth grant in ~/.claude/.credentials.json is a subscription token, not an API key, and is never copied here. After ingest: `dsh-credentials-bridge.py push anthropic`.

openai.note: Consumer: dsh provider openai (managed ref OPENAI_API_KEY). Endpoint verified 2026-09-03 without a key: GET /v1/models -> 401 "Missing bearer authentication in header". ~/.codex/auth.json is auth_mode chatgpt with OPENAI_API_KEY null: Codex CLI runs on the ChatGPT subscription OAuth, which is not an API key and is never copied here; dsh's own `openai-codex` provider is OAuth-only (pi-ai loadOpenAICodexOAuth). key-health model gpt-4o-mini must be confirmed at the first probe. After ingest: `dsh-credentials-bridge.py push openai`.

deepgram.note: Authorization: Token（不是 Bearer）。只在 runner 沒有 GPU 又趕時間時用；本機 whisper 品質更好且不外送會議內容。

opencode-zen.note: OpenCode Zen gateway; free models carry the -free suffix (muse-spark-1.3-contributor-free, big-pickle, nemotron-3.5-lightning-free); quota refills ~08:00 next day (Threads @ccckmit 2026-10-01)

typesafe.note: Jev (FAMES skill advisor, _harness/runtime/jev_turn_router.py). Paid: jev-1.13.0 $0.042 per M input tokens, output free; keys only from the console (docs.typesafe.ai/introduction/quickstart). Operator authorized Jev 2026-10-15.

render.note: ADDED 2026-10-21: ziyaoastro backend moves Fly -> Render Free; the key lets render-env-sync.py push env vars from the vault without any value reaching chat.
